parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use the product rule. M1. Obtain the derivative in any correct form, e.g. \(2e^{2x}(\sin x+3\cos x)+e^{2x}(\cos x-3\sin x)\). A1. Equate the derivative to zero and obtain an equation in one trigonometric ratio. M1. Obtain \(x=1.43\) only. A1. Total [4].

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use a correct method to determine the nature of the stationary point. M1. For example, at \(x=1.42\), \(y'=0.06e^{2.84}>0\), and at \(x=1.44\), \(y'=-0.07e^{2.88}<0\). Show that it is a maximum point. A1. Total [2].
